{"summary":"Implemented triage.sh to handle .log and .log.gz, normalize volatile IDs (orderId, providerTxnId, traceId, requestId), skip healthcheck lines, and output counts sorted descending.","files":[{"path":"scripts/triage.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Function to normalize volatile IDs
normalize_ids() {
    sed -E 's/orderId=[0-9]+/orderId=XXX/g; s/providerTxnId=[A-Z0-9-]+/providerTxnId=XXX/g; s/traceId=[A-Z0-9]+/traceId=XXX/g; s/requestId=[A-Z0-9]+/requestId=XXX/g'
}

# Function to process a log file (handles both plain and gzipped)
process_log() {
    local file="$1"
    local content
    
    if [[ "$file" == *.gz ]]; then
        content=$(gzip -dc "$file")
    else
        content=$(cat "$file")
    fi
    
    # Filter out healthcheck lines
    echo "$content" | grep -v 'healthcheck' | normalize_ids
}

# Main logic
main() {
    local logs=("$@")
    declare -A counts
    
    for log in "${logs[@]}"; do
        process_log "$log" | while IFS= read -r line; do
            # Skip empty lines
            [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
            
            # Extract the message part (after the timestamp and level)
            # Format: TIMESTAMP LEVEL MESSAGE
            local msg
            msg=$(echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z (INFO|ERROR|WARN) //' )
            
            # Count occurrences
            ((counts["$msg"]++)) || true
        done
    done
    
    # Output sorted by count descending
    for msg in "${!counts[@]}"; do
        echo "${counts[$msg]} $msg"
    done | sort -rn
}

main "$@"
"}]
